results.question: 最近7天按订单口径退款率最高的3个品类是哪些？
results.golden_sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(substr(create_time,1,10)) AS today FROM orders), order_cat AS (SELECT i.order_id, p.category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.order_id ORDER BY i.quantity*i.unit_price DESC) AS rn FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id CROSS JOIN latest WHERE substr(o.create_time,1,10) >= date(latest.today,'-6 day')) SELECT oc.category, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)*100.0/COUNT(DISTINCT oc.order_id),1) AS refund_rate FROM order_cat oc LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id=oc.order_id WHERE oc.rn=1 GROUP BY oc.category ORDER BY refund_rate DESC, oc.category LIMIT 3
results.agent_sql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(substr(create_time, 1, 10)) AS today FROM orders),
     order_cat AS (
       SELECT i.order_id, p.category,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.order_id ORDER BY i.quantity * i.unit_price DESC) AS rn
       FROM order_items i 
       JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id)
SELECT oc.category,
       ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 1) AS refund_rate
FROM orders o
JOIN latest ON o.create_time >= date(latest.today, '-6 day')
JOIN order_cat oc ON oc.order_id = o.order_id AND oc.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN refunds f ON f.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY oc.category
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC
LIMIT 3

results.question: 各品类的金额退款率是多少？（该品类退款金额占该品类GMV的百分比，订单按主品类归属）
results.golden_sql: WITH order_cat AS (SELECT i.order_id, p.category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.order_id ORDER BY i.quantity*i.unit_price DESC) AS rn FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id), cat_gmv AS (SELECT oc.category, SUM(o.total_amount) AS gmv FROM order_cat oc JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oc.order_id WHERE oc.rn=1 GROUP BY oc.category), cat_refund AS (SELECT oc.category, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS amt FROM refunds r JOIN order_cat oc ON oc.order_id=r.order_id AND oc.rn=1 GROUP BY oc.category) SELECT g.category, ROUND(COALESCE(f.amt,0)*100.0/g.gmv,1) AS amount_refund_rate FROM cat_gmv g LEFT JOIN cat_refund f ON f.category=g.category ORDER BY amount_refund_rate DESC, g.category
results.agent_sql:
WITH order_cat AS (
  SELECT i.order_id, p.category,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.order_id ORDER BY i.quantity * i.unit_price DESC) AS rn
  FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id)
SELECT oc.category,

results.question: 美妆品类中退款率最高的3个商品是哪些？（订单口径，百分比）
results.golden_sql: WITH pi AS (SELECT i.order_id, i.product_id FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.category='美妆') SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)*100.0/COUNT(DISTINCT pi.order_id),1) AS refund_rate FROM pi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=pi.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id=pi.order_id GROUP BY pi.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY refund_rate DESC, p.product_name LIMIT 3
results.agent_sql:
WITH beauty_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, i.product_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.category = '美妆'
),
beauty_refund_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.order_id, i.product_id
  FROM refunds r
  JOIN order_items i ON r.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.category = '美妆'
),
product_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bo.order_id) AS total_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bro.order_id) AS refund_orders
  FROM products p
  LEFT JOIN beauty_orders bo ON p.product_id = bo.product_id
  LEFT JOIN beauty_refund_orders bro ON p.product_id = bro.product_id
  WHERE p.category = '美妆'
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
)
SELECT 
  product_name,
  ROUND(COALESCE(refund_orders * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_orders, 0), 0), 1) AS refund_rate
FROM product_stats
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC
LIMIT 3
